# CLI Reference

Autogenerated reference for every `honeyhive` command, grouped by namespace.

- [Configurations](./configurations) — Manage prompt configurations — model parameters, message templates, and response settings — that can be versioned and deployed without code changes. _(4 commands)_
- [Datapoints](./datapoints) — Manage individual records inside datasets, including batch creation and mapping to source events. _(6 commands)_
- [Datasets](./datasets) — Curate collections of datapoints used as test sets for evaluations and experiments. _(6 commands)_
- [Events](./events) — Read and write trace events — the spans that capture every step of an AI application's execution. _(7 commands)_
- [Experiments](./experiments) — Run, retrieve, and compare evaluation runs to measure how prompt or configuration changes affect agent performance. _(9 commands)_
- [Metrics](./metrics) — Define and run evaluators — automated quality checks that score traces against criteria like accuracy, safety, or correctness. _(5 commands)_
- [Queues](./queues) — Manage annotation queues for human review of traces, turning expert feedback into labeled datasets. _(5 commands)_
- [Sessions](./sessions) — Group related trace events into sessions, the top-level container for a multi-step or multi-service AI interaction. _(2 commands)_
